title: Internal: handling procedure for issuing an approved Bill of Lading or Sea Waybill
content:
## Scope of application

Under the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product, an approved transport document is issued under the product's issuance rules once its cargo has been shipped on board, and the issuance puts the originals of the set in force into circulation. This entry describes the issuing action and its observable effect.

## Business effect

One issuance:

- moves the document from approved to issued, with the current day as its date of issue;
- adds one issuance fee charge for the set in force to the documentation account, raising the documentation charges due by that fee;
- when the given number of originals is above zero, records those originals as put into circulation and adds them to the originals outstanding; when the number given is zero, no originals entry is recorded.

Afterwards the customer sees the document as issued, the issuance fee and the originals in circulation.

## How it is invoked

issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be is an internal tool: the agent unlocks it first (unlock) and then calls it (call).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the approved transport document to issue, as returned by the transport document lookup for the bill of lading number the caller quotes | Id text |
| booking_id | Reference number of the booking the document covers, as shown on the transport document record and returned by the booking lookup | Id text |
| originals_count | How many original documents of the set in force are put into circulation | Whole number, 0 or more, no decimals |
| issuance_fee_usd | The issuance fee booked for the set, in USD | Written to 2 decimal places, no currency sign |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the issuance-fee entry reference (an opaque text id beginning "bif_"), the originals-issued entry reference (beginning "boi_", or the word none when 0 originals were given and no originals entry was recorded), the transport document reference, the booking reference, the set number, the fee in USD with 2 decimal places, the originals put into circulation and the originals now outstanding. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal; the document then shows the status issued.

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** What does the customer see if the call is made with zero originals? **Answer:** The document is issued and the issuance fee is booked, but no originals entry is recorded; the return names none for the originals entry.
- **Question:** Which set does the issuance fee charge? **Answer:** The set in force on the document at the moment of issue.
